title: The Cistern Winter Inquiry
player_facing_question: What failed at the cistern, who knew, and why does the surviving file blame the first worker who reported it?
plausible_initial_belief: Nessa mishandled samples, let dirty water through, and was dismissed after a preventable mistake.
human_stake: Nessa Vale followed the pump procedure and lost her work, home issue, and name in the public record. Toma inherited her shift without knowing he was being used to rewrite the chronology. Averyn risked her office to preserve the exhibits.
earned_belief: Genuine cloth and charcoal were diverted, counterfeit cloth failed, the rota and complaint record were edited, and officials suppressed Averyn's inquiry. Nessa reported the failure in order and must be cleared completely.
required_inference: Players must build one chain joining early complaints, material failure, diversion, counterfeit provenance, shift editing, and suppression. Finding counterfeit cloth alone or proving Nessa complained is true but not enough to clear her.
callback: Sella's omitted lower sample, Vaun's unexplained balances, Brann's paired-watch correction, and Iss's polished mercy language become parts of one human case rather than six isolated dossier details.

consequence.minecraft: Nessa's name returns to the pump roster with the neutral finding CLEARED BY ORIGINAL EXHIBITS; the disciplinary placard moves into the evidence cabinet rather than disappearing.
consequence.npc: Toma records that he took relief after the shedding began and leaves Nessa a short apology without asking for forgiveness.
consequence.copperline: A cached attachment reveals the unredacted supplier revision history and preserves both Draft A and Draft B.
consequence.discord: The docket closes with separate material-cause, record-falsification, and Nessa-conduct findings so later summaries cannot collapse them.

evidence.title: Pump labels 14–19
evidence.author: Nessa Vale
evidence.medium: oil-pencil labels on sealed sample necks
evidence.provenance: continuous Nessa hand; seals initialed before removal date; A-lower label 16 survives in Averyn cache
evidence.content: 14 lower: pressure falling, grit dark. 15 upper: clear. 16 lower: same dark grit, before cloth threads. 17 lower: pale fibers now present. 18 upper: fibers. 19 relief taken by Toma; repeat both draws.
evidence.accessibility: shape-coded jars and exact text ledger duplicate color observations
evidence.clue_job: Places pressure and grit before cloth shedding and before Toma relieved Nessa.

evidence.title: Nessa's third complaint
evidence.author: Nessa Vale
evidence.medium: signed workplace complaint with intake stamps
evidence.provenance: three intake stamps; first two listed as resolved without response; third later reclassified as discipline
evidence.content: I have repeated lower draw because the pressure loss begins there. Sample 16 contains grit before fibers. I am not refusing the cloth ruling; I am asking stores to show which cloth reached us. If you remove me, write that I asked before the water turned.
evidence.clue_job: Shows procedure compliance and the exact question officials avoided.

evidence.title: Fixed flow section
evidence.author: Averyn Pell
evidence.provenance: dimensions match installed pipe; no movable frames; annotations precede disciplinary draft
evidence.content: A pressure drop at lower draw with clear upper water cannot begin at Nessa's sample sink. The failure lies upstream between lower intake and split, before the operator-controlled return.
evidence.accessibility: diagram uses labels, line styles, and text; no color-only or geometry-perfect deduction
evidence.clue_job: Locates failure outside Nessa's control without requiring players to configure a model.

evidence.title: A-lower custody chain
evidence.author: Nessa, Toma, Averyn
evidence.provenance: three sequential signatures; stable exhibit id; local mirror in inquiry office
evidence.content: Nessa sealed sample 16. Toma received the locked tray at relief and noted the seal unbroken. Averyn opened it with both present, retained half, and returned half to the public rack. The retained half matches the original label fibers and grit.
evidence.clue_job: Protects the material finding from claims that Averyn substituted the sample later.

evidence.title: Cloth under work light
evidence.author: Toma Rei and Sella Mor
evidence.provenance: authentic market remnant and failed cistern strip retain distinct seal fibers; Sella sketch corroborates
evidence.content: Original cloth: paired warp, charcoal sizing, blue seal thread inside hem. Failed strip: single warp, chalk sizing, seal thread sewn through after cutting. In water the failed strip sheds pale fibers like samples 17–19.
evidence.accessibility: raised-pattern diagram and textual weave description; touch/color is not mandatory
evidence.clue_job: Establishes counterfeit material and explains the change from grit to fibers.

evidence.title: Relief chronology
evidence.author: Brann Iles, Toma Rei, Neri Vos
evidence.medium: rota, stair repair mark, and meal chit
evidence.provenance: independent work systems share ninth-bell relief; clean rota later overwrites it as eighth
evidence.content: Brann's corrected rota puts Toma at the pump after ninth bell. Toma's fresh mortar mark is completed before he descends. Neri issues his meal at relief. The public disciplinary draft moves Toma to eighth bell so every fiber sample appears under Nessa's watch.
evidence.accessibility: chronology rendered as ordered text as well as marks
evidence.clue_job: Proves the shift was edited to assign later evidence to Nessa.

evidence.title: Merrit Textile invoice
evidence.author: Merrit Textile Cooperative
evidence.provenance: real supplier format; initially appears to support official purchase
evidence.content: Twelve cistern-grade bolts, paired warp, charcoal sized, inner blue seal. Ship against Vaun receiving 44. The invoice is genuine; the goods present at the cistern are not the goods it describes.
evidence.accessibility: OCR corrected against scan; layout and seal described
evidence.clue_job: A genuine invoice creates the plausible but wrong belief that procurement was sound.

evidence.title: Purchase copy and market thread
evidence.author: Orris Pell, Vaun, unknown clerk
evidence.provenance: cached first attachment names Merrit; edited attachment substitutes North Cut Salvage after receipt; file timestamps align with diversion
evidence.content: The paid amount matches cistern-grade cloth. The later attached delivery list names a cheaper salvage lot and carries copied seal marks. Vaun's private balance puts five genuine bolts in favored heat galleries during the same week.
evidence.accessibility: version chronology and diffs are text-readable
evidence.clue_job: Joins counterfeit procurement to deliberate diversion rather than simple supplier error.

evidence.title: Reeds cache instruction
evidence.author: Ash; source context by Sella
evidence.medium: hash-bound clip 2 with stills and transcript
evidence.provenance: clip_02_reeds_cache exact SHA-1 9b979e349c7a0d7497fd0fe76d0450e744dc39d0; earned only after procurement finding
evidence.content: WHERE THE REEDS FOLD BACK identifies Sella's lower-intake landmark, not a poetic riddle. Fixed stills show the bent alder, split sill, and reverse reed shelf; an indexed diagram supplies the same route without sound or video-only observation.
evidence.accessibility: captioned transcript, fixed still sequence, and landmark diagram
evidence.clue_job: Uses earlier survey provenance to locate Averyn's protected originals.

evidence.title: Averyn's cache packet
evidence.author: Averyn Pell
evidence.medium: original filter strip, receipt, Draft A, Draft B, and cover note
evidence.provenance: cache seal matches sample 16; Draft A corrections precede council Draft B; original receipt matches invoice
evidence.content: Draft A: Nessa followed sampling and escalation procedure; genuine stock was diverted; substitute cloth failed. Draft B: operator variance preceded material uncertainty. Averyn's cover note reads: They asked me to make the first sentence less final. The evidence did not become less final.
evidence.accessibility: all physical exhibits have exact archive descriptions; material texture is redundant
evidence.clue_job: Completes exoneration and establishes deliberate institutional rewriting.

conclusions.prompt: Where did the physical failure begin and what failed?
accepted_answers: The failure began upstream of Nessa at the lower intake: genuine cloth was diverted and counterfeit single-warp cloth shed into the water.

conclusions.prompt: Who handled the later fiber samples and how was that hidden?
accepted_answers: Toma took relief after ninth bell, but the clean rota moved him to eighth so later fiber samples would be attributed to Nessa.

conclusions.prompt: File the complete finding on Nessa Vale.
accepted_answers: Nessa followed procedure and reported pressure loss and grit before cloth shedding. Genuine supplies were diverted, counterfeit cloth failed, her shift and complaint records were edited, and Averyn's exonerating inquiry was suppressed.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: The counterfeit supplier alone caused the crisis.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: The inquiry accepts material fraud but returns the genuine invoice, diverted stock, copied seals, and edited rota: failure required internal allocation and concealment.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: Nessa was innocent but careless paperwork made her look guilty.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: Her innocence is supported; 'careless' is rejected because stamps, attachment replacement, shift alteration, and Draft B all move evidence in the same protective direction.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: Averyn fabricated a cleaner chain later to save Nessa.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: The cache is meaningful, but the finding remains closed until the independent Nessa–Toma seal chain, early complaint stamps, and market/rota chronology are addressed.

hints.H0: Separate the inquiry into material/flow, labor/time, and procurement/record lanes.
hints.H1: Start with Nessa's numbered labels; they state what changed before and after relief.
hints.H2: Test every official claim against a source produced for another job: market, stairs, watch, stores, or supplier custody.
hints.H3: Use sample 16 and the fixed flow section; authentic versus failed weave; ninth-bell relief; the changed purchase attachment; and Averyn's Draft A/B packet.

runtime.replay: complete public inquiry brief with exhibit provenance and Nessa conduct finding
runtime.restart: draft findings, cache reveal, artifact custody, and exoneration event reload idempotently
runtime.outage: media has local still/diagram equivalent; Copperline/Discord projections queue; local inquiry remains completable

novelty_comparison: P7 is adversarial forensic custody, not P6 biography. Evidence produced by unrelated jobs cross-authenticates one worker's case; the emotional climax is public exoneration, not artifact collection.
cold_theory_paths: operator fault -> material failure -> coordinated scapegoating
bad supplier -> internal diversion -> falsified inquiry
Averyn partisan -> independent custody -> suppressed analyst
